title: AI query namedSets expressions are validated, not concatenated verbatim — injection is refused with a typed VALIDATION_ERROR and legitimate named sets still emit

criteria.given: the issue's injection body — a namedSets[].expression that closes the set (leading '})') and appends its own MEMBER definition — on POST /ai/query/preview
criteria.then: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR pointing at namedSets[0].expression; no generatedMdx containing an injected MEMBER reaches the caller (MCP run_query / preview_query ride the same AiSchemaConverter, so they refuse the same body)

criteria.given: the same injection body on POST /ai/query (execute)
criteria.then: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR before any MDX is executed — the query is refused, never run

criteria.given: a legitimate named-set expression over a known Product hierarchy ({[Product].[Products].[Product Family].Members}) on POST /ai/query/preview
criteria.then: 200 PREVIEW with generatedMdx carrying WITH SET and the expression as submitted — no keyword or comment ban trips on ordinary set expressions

steps.name: injected named-set expression is refused on preview with a typed validation error
injected named-set expression is refused on execute before any MDX runs
a legitimate named-set expression still emits into the WITH SET clause
